valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the income statement and the balance sheet share no period (income newest FY2016, balance newest FY2015), so earnings, book value and the market cap cannot be put on one period. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
